[P2] Supply the required approved design note

This introduces a public subpath with factories, transports, and options, but the supplied description contains an implementation summary rather than the design note required by CONTRIBUTING rule 3. It does not identify the problem, cause, simpler alternatives, chosen approach, removals, or maintainer agreement. Experimental APIs still fall under that rule. Return to the design phase and include or explicitly link the agreed note, including uncovered defaults and decisions required by rule 7.
